cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved my tea without milk. You may attempt to handle something equally strong.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: May I just drink mine? Same teapot, but the milk cooled it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Drinking is approved. First to finish wins; I've only got two mouthfuls left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've finished. Can I make another?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Refill granted. That counts against you in the endurance round. I can make these two mouthfuls last all breakfast.
